name: voyage
description: Trip planning that checks its own work. Five skills — plan, research, audit, pack, replan — built on a shared verification ledger: every place carries an address, a primary source and an evidence date; every day is checked for whether it can physically be walked; every plan is scored against the constraints you actually stated. Research finishes before the itinerary is written, so venues can't be invented to fill a shape. Try: 'plan a week in Norway in September' or 'audit this itinerary'.
